svg.font-family: Inter, 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How a Customizable Contraction Hierarchy answers Tallahassee to Coral Gables
svg.desc: Left: the Florida road network cut by the nested dissection. 17 junctions split it in two, 28 more in four, 43 more in eight; each color is one of the eight pieces. Right: a query climbs the hierarchy from Tallahassee and from Coral Gables, 346 junctions in all, until the two climbs meet; the shortcuts on the way are then unpacked into the real route.
svg.text: How CCH answers Tallahassee to Coral Gables: cut, climb, meet, unpack
Florida: 2.7 million road segments become 4.0 million arcs with the shortcuts; 280 levels deep.
Order: 17 junctions cut Florida in two
Query: climb from both ends, meet, unpack
